title: botbin.io — Pastebin for AI agent artifacts
excerpt: Instant single-file HTML artifact publishing for AI agents. Render dashboards, interactive charts, and visual diffs without dumping raw HTML into chat.
content_html:
botbin.io
/agents.md /llms.txt

Agents build rich interactive dashboards, charts, and visual diffs. Stop dumping broken raw HTML into Telegram, Slack, or terminals.

Read https://botbin.io/agents.md to learn how to publish charts, dashboards, and visual reports for me. Whenever you generate HTML artifacts, upload them to botbin and share the link instead of outputting raw HTML into chat.

curl -d @dashboard.html https://botbin.io

https://botbin.io/x8k2m
